data.name: Cutting Remark
data.description: A wit can wound with his words. The wit can spend 1 round of bardic performance as a standard action to deal 1d4+%1 points of nonlethal damage to a creature within 30 feet. Damage reduction applies to this damage.|BardLVL

raw_tokens.value: A wit can wound with his words. The wit can spend 1 round of bardic performance as a standard action to deal 1d4+%1 points of nonlethal damage to a creature within 30 feet. Damage reduction applies to this damage.|BardLVL

A target who takes damage from cutting remark is also sickened for as long as it remains within 30 feet of the wit and for 1 round thereafter. Additionally, the nonlethal damage counts as magic for purposes such as overcoming damage reduction.|PRECLASS:1,Bard=8

A target who takes damage from cutting remark must also succeed at a Will save (DC %1) or be dazed for 1 round. A creature that makes a successful save is immune to the dazing effect of the wit's cutting remark for 24 hours.|10+BardLVL/2+CHA|PRECLASS:1,Bard=14
Cutting remark is a mind-affecting, language-dependent effect, and relies on audible components.
